name: PCBench
description: Measurement harness, pinned software environment (Dockerfile), run scripts and the complete raw results (JSON, CSV, LaTeX table, figures) behind Appendix A of the review article "From Data Collection to Geospatial Intelligence: Trends, Pitfalls, and a Research Agenda for Next-Generation Mobile Mapping" (E. Khoramshahi, submitted to Geomatics, MDPI, 2026; preprint doi:10.20944/preprints202609.1349.v1). Four point-cloud backbones (PTv3, LitePT, SpUNet, PTv2) are measured on one GPU under one protocol on Paris-Lille-3D and SensatUrban crops of 10^5 to 10^7 points. The point clouds are not included; scripts/fetch_data.sh retrieves and verifies them from their public sources. Code: MIT; results and documentation: CC BY 4.0. See README.md.
